+		if a.filterState[i].key != b.filterState[i].key ||
+			a.filterState[i].terminal != b.filterState[i].terminal {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	if (a.sourceIp == nil) != (b.sourceIp == nil) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if a.sourceIp != nil && b.sourceIp != nil {
+		if a.sourceIp.terminal != b.sourceIp.terminal {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}

+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, h := range c.headers {
+		if h.regexRewrite != nil {
+			if err := h.regexRewrite.Validate(); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			if h.regexRewrite.GetPattern() != nil {
+				if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.regexRewrite.GetPattern().GetRegex()); err != nil {
+					return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern: %w", err)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	for _, cookie := range c.cookies {
+		if cookie.ttl != nil {
+			if err := cookie.ttl.CheckValid(); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+		for _, attr := range cookie.attributes {
+			if err := attr.Validate(); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+func (c *consistentHashIR) Clone() *consistentHashIR {

+	if c.headers != nil {

+		for i, h := range c.headers {
+			clone.headers[i] = h.Clone()
+		}

+	if c.cookies != nil {
+		clone.cookies = make([]HashPolicyCookieIR, len(c.cookies))
+		for i, cookie := range c.cookies {
+			clone.cookies[i] = cookie.Clone()
+		}
+	}
+	if c.queryParameters != nil {
+		clone.queryParameters = make([]HashPolicyQueryParameterIR, len(c.queryParameters))
+		copy(clone.queryParameters, c.queryParameters)
+	}
+	if c.filterState != nil {
+		clone.filterState = make([]HashPolicyFilterStateIR, len(c.filterState))
+		copy(clone.filterState, c.filterState)
+	}
+	if c.sourceIp != nil {
+		clone.sourceIp = &HashPolicySourceIPIR{
+			terminal: c.sourceIp.terminal,
+		}

+func parseCookieTTL(ttlStr string) (*durationpb.Duration, error) {
+	if d, err := time.ParseDuration(ttlStr); err == nil {
+		if d < 0 {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl cannot be negative: %s", ttlStr)
+		}
+		return durationpb.New(d), nil
+	}
+	if sec, err := strconv.ParseInt(ttlStr, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if sec < 0 {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl cannot be negative: %s", ttlStr)
+		}
+		return durationpb.New(time.Duration(sec) * time.Second), nil
+	}
+	return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: must be a Go duration or integer seconds", ttlStr)
+}

+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+
+	if ch.Disable != nil && *ch.Disable {
+		if len(ch.Headers) > 0 || len(ch.Cookies) > 0 || len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 || len(ch.FilterState) > 0 || ch.SourceIp != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("when disable is true, no other fields may be set")
+		}
+		out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			disabled: true,
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ir := &consistentHashIR{}
+
+	// Headers: deduplicate by case-insensitive headerName, preserving casing of first occurrence
+	seenHeaders := make(map[string]struct{})
+	for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+		lower := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+		if _, exists := seenHeaders[lower]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenHeaders[lower] = struct{}{}
+
+		var regexRewrite *envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.RegexRewrite.Pattern); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern: %w", err)
+			}
+			regexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+
+		terminal := false
+		if h.Terminal != nil {
+			terminal = *h.Terminal
+		}
+
+		ir.headers = append(ir.headers, HashPolicyHeaderIR{
+			headerName:   h.HeaderName,
+			regexRewrite: regexRewrite,
+			terminal:     terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// Cookies: deduplicate by name, preserving first occurrence
+	seenCookies := make(map[string]struct{})
+	for _, c := range ch.Cookies {
+		if _, exists := seenCookies[c.Name]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenCookies[c.Name] = struct{}{}
+
+		var ttl *durationpb.Duration
+		if c.TTL != nil && *c.TTL != "" {
+			d, err := parseCookieTTL(*c.TTL)
+			if err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			ttl = d
+		}
+
+		var attrs []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute
+		for _, a := range c.Attributes {
+			attrs = append(attrs, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+				Name:  a.Name,
+				Value: a.Value,
+			})
+		}
+
+		var path string
+		if c.Path != nil {
+			path = *c.Path
+		}
+
+		terminal := false
+		if c.Terminal != nil {
+			terminal = *c.Terminal
+		}
+
+		ir.cookies = append(ir.cookies, HashPolicyCookieIR{
+			name:       c.Name,
+			path:       path,
+			ttl:        ttl,
+			attributes: attrs,
+			terminal:   terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// QueryParameters: deduplicate by name, preserving first occurrence
+	seenQP := make(map[string]struct{})
+	for _, qp := range ch.QueryParameters {
+		if _, exists := seenQP[qp.Name]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenQP[qp.Name] = struct{}{}
+
+		terminal := false
+		if qp.Terminal != nil {
+			terminal = *qp.Terminal
+		}
+
+		ir.queryParameters = append(ir.queryParameters, HashPolicyQueryParameterIR{
+			name:     qp.Name,
+			terminal: terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// FilterState: deduplicate by key, preserving first occurrence
+	seenFS := make(map[string]struct{})
+	for _, fs := range ch.FilterState {
+		if _, exists := seenFS[fs.Key]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenFS[fs.Key] = struct{}{}
+
+		terminal := false
+		if fs.Terminal != nil {
+			terminal = *fs.Terminal
+		}
+
+		ir.filterState = append(ir.filterState, HashPolicyFilterStateIR{
+			key:      fs.Key,
+			terminal: terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// Source IP
+	if ch.SourceIp != nil {
+		terminal := false
+		if ch.SourceIp.Terminal != nil {
+			terminal = *ch.SourceIp.Terminal
+		}
+		ir.sourceIp = &HashPolicySourceIPIR{
+			terminal: terminal,
+		}
+	}
+
+	out.consistentHash = ir
+	return nil
+}

+func (c *consistentHashIR) toEnvoyHashPolicies() []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if c == nil || c.disabled {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	var policies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	// 1. Headers
+	for _, h := range c.headers {
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+				Header: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+					HeaderName:   h.headerName,
+					RegexRewrite: h.regexRewrite,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: h.terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 2. Cookies
+	for _, cookie := range c.cookies {
+		var attrs []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute
+		if len(cookie.attributes) > 0 {
+			attrs = make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, len(cookie.attributes))
+			for i, a := range cookie.attributes {
+				attrs[i] = proto.Clone(a).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute)
+			}
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+				Cookie: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+					Name:       cookie.name,
+					Path:       cookie.path,
+					Ttl:        cookie.ttl,
+					Attributes: attrs,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: cookie.terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 3. QueryParameters
+	for _, qp := range c.queryParameters {
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: qp.name,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: qp.terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 4. FilterState
+	for _, fs := range c.filterState {
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: fs.key,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: fs.terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 5. SourceIp
+	if c.sourceIp != nil {
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: c.sourceIp.terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 1. When consistentHash is set (even as empty {}), the RouteAction must include hash_policy entries.
+	// If no sub-fields are specified, default to a single sourceIp hash policy with terminal=false.
+	if len(policies) == 0 {
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: false,
+		})
+	}
+
+	return policies
+}
+
+func applyConsistentHash(consistentHash *consistentHashIR, out *envoyroutev3.Route) {
+	if consistentHash == nil || out == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	action := out.GetRoute()
+	if action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if consistentHash.disabled {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+	action.HashPolicy = consistentHash.toEnvoyHashPolicies()
+}
+
+func mergeConsistentHash(
+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	opts policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	_ TrafficPolicyMergeOpts,
+) {
+	if p2 == nil || p2.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if p1.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = p2.spec.consistentHash.Clone()
+		mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}
+
+	// Both p1 and p2 have consistentHash configured.
+	// p1 is higher priority, p2 is lower priority.
+	// If p1 is disabled, all broader-scoped policies are suppressed.
+	if p1.spec.consistentHash.disabled {
+		return
+	}
+
+	// If p2 is disabled, it cannot contribute any policies to p1.
+	if p2.spec.consistentHash.disabled {
+		return
+	}
+
+	// Union array fields with higher-priority (p1) entries first, deduplicated by key.
+	addedFromP2 := false
+
+	// 1. Headers: deduplicated by case-insensitive headerName
+	seenHeaders := make(map[string]struct{}, len(p1.spec.consistentHash.headers))
+	for _, h := range p1.spec.consistentHash.headers {
+		seenHeaders[strings.ToLower(h.headerName)] = struct{}{}
+	}
+	for _, h := range p2.spec.consistentHash.headers {
+		lower := strings.ToLower(h.headerName)
+		if _, exists := seenHeaders[lower]; !exists {
+			seenHeaders[lower] = struct{}{}
+			p1.spec.consistentHash.headers = append(p1.spec.consistentHash.headers, h.Clone())
+			addedFromP2 = true
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 2. Cookies: deduplicated by name
+	seenCookies := make(map[string]struct{}, len(p1.spec.consistentHash.cookies))
+	for _, c := range p1.spec.consistentHash.cookies {
+		seenCookies[c.name] = struct{}{}
+	}
+	for _, c := range p2.spec.consistentHash.cookies {
+		if _, exists := seenCookies[c.name]; !exists {
+			seenCookies[c.name] = struct{}{}
+			p1.spec.consistentHash.cookies = append(p1.spec.consistentHash.cookies, c.Clone())
+			addedFromP2 = true
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 3. QueryParameters: deduplicated by name
+	seenQP := make(map[string]struct{}, len(p1.spec.consistentHash.queryParameters))
+	for _, qp := range p1.spec.consistentHash.queryParameters {
+		seenQP[qp.name] = struct{}{}
+	}
+	for _, qp := range p2.spec.consistentHash.queryParameters {
+		if _, exists := seenQP[qp.name]; !exists {
+			seenQP[qp.name] = struct{}{}
+			p1.spec.consistentHash.queryParameters = append(p1.spec.consistentHash.queryParameters, qp)
+			addedFromP2 = true
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 4. FilterState: deduplicated by key
+	seenFS := make(map[string]struct{}, len(p1.spec.consistentHash.filterState))
+	for _, fs := range p1.spec.consistentHash.filterState {
+		seenFS[fs.key] = struct{}{}
+	}
+	for _, fs := range p2.spec.consistentHash.filterState {
+		if _, exists := seenFS[fs.key]; !exists {
+			seenFS[fs.key] = struct{}{}
+			p1.spec.consistentHash.filterState = append(p1.spec.consistentHash.filterState, fs)
+			addedFromP2 = true
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 5. sourceIp:
+	// "The sourceIp scalar retains the higher-priority policy's value even when unset."
+	// Therefore, p1.spec.consistentHash.sourceIp is unchanged!
+
+	if addedFromP2 {
+		mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+	}
+}
